text:
ash: Quick sync  launching a tiny Plugin Refapp + three micro-tutorials over the next 3 weeks. Need owners for: tutorial drafts, benchmark one-liner + repo scripts, LP variants, webinar office hour, and inbound routing. Volunteers?

riley: I can take the tutorials (3 short posts: quickstart, optimize, deploy). Will keep each ~450-650 words and include runnable snippets.

maya: I9ll run a lightweight benchmark sweep and produce a single hero stat + reproducible script. Plan: default vs batching+cache on 300-token demo.

gita: I'll own LP design + email CTAs and map inbound segments. Propose CTAs: "Run the plugin now" (A) and "See the cost & latency wins" (B). Will do A/B.

ash: Nice. Quick asks: 1) Maya, please keep headline conservative and link to raw CSV. 2) Riley, add a 2-line CLI hero snippet and a GIF. 3) Gita, add partner/maintainer microflow.

maya: Tentative hero line: "Up to ~30% lower unit cost with batching and prefix caching; p99 within interactive SLOs." I'll qualify with sample sizes and link to bench scripts.

riley: CLI hero snippet: ```bash
ri plugin start --example quickstart
``` Will make GIF of that running.

gita: Routing: three segments  trial users, OSS contributors, partners/maintainers. Partners get early-review invite and private slack. Add UTM tags and a CRM webhook.

ash: Webinar ops: short 30m office hour (15m demo, 10m live Qs, 5m next steps). Cap 300, record and email replay. Who can host demo?

riley: I can demo the plugin and walk through the refapp.

maya: Infra ask: ~90 GPU minutes for benchmark runs across 3 models. Approve?

gita: Approved 90 GPU minutes. Please log runs on GH issue plugin-refapp-bench.

riley: Draft ETA: tutorials PR in 72h. Will include code snippets, GIFs, and README.

maya: I'll attach CSV + short Python repro script to the repo. Hero stat may change after full sweep.

gita: LP note: hero A will be code-first (GIF) with CTA "Run the plugin now"; hero B will be benchmark-first with a small stat strip and CTA "Compare performance". Also want a small testimonial slot for maintainers.

nash: Good. Email drip plan: T0 announce, T+2 tutorial #1 + webinar invite, T+6 tutorial #2, T+10 webinar reminder + tutorial #3 + replay. Partner stream gets T0 early-access CTA.

riley: Will include tiny README checklist for maintainers and a CONTRIBUTING.md snippet for plugin authors.

maya: Reminder: keep public claims conservative and always link to reproducibles.

launch-bot: Reminder set: create GH issue "plugin-refapp-launch-playbook" and assign owners in 6 hours.

gita: I'll share LP mocks and email copy in #marketing-drafts by EOD tomorrow.

riley: One blocker: need small social promo budget for week-of push. Asking $500.

ash: Approved $500. Track UTMs.

maya: Owners recap: Riley=content & demo, Maya=bench & reproducibles, Gita=LP & routing, Ash=overall PM. Please post blockers to the GH issue. :rocket:
